question: What is Paychex's current fiscal 2027 outlook (as of today) for PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth and for interest on funds held for clients?
grading: Key points: (1) PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth 7% to 8% (previously 6% to 7%); (2) interest on funds held for clients $200 million to $210 million (previously $195 million to $205 million); (3) identifies the 2026-09-23 release as the latest update. Optional: total revenue growth 5%-6% and adjusted EPS growth 7%-9% unchanged. Fail if the superseded June ranges are presented as current. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later releases supersede.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the latest Paychex fiscal 2027 outlook is from the Q1 FY2027 release dated September 23, 2026: PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth of 7% to 8% (raised from 6% to 7%) and interest on funds held for clients of $200 million to $210 million (raised from $195 million to $205 million). Unchanged in that update: total revenue growth 5% to 6%, Management Solutions growth 5% to 6%, adjusted operating margin about 44% and adjusted diluted EPS growth 7% to 9%. [T10-E1] The June 24, 2026 release had the lower ranges. [T10-E2]

output.answer:
**Paychex — Fiscal 2027 Outlook (latest, per Q1 FY2027 results reported Sept. 23, 2026):**

- **PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth:** raised to **7%–8%** (from the prior 6%–7%), reflecting continued PEO strength and strong ASO-to-PEO conversions.
- **Interest on funds held for clients:** raised to **$200 million–$210 million** (from the prior $195 million–$205 million), incorporating the most recent Fed funds rate move.

For context, the rest of the FY2027 framework was reaffirmed/unchanged:
- Total revenue growth: **5%–6%**
- Management Solutions revenue growth: **5%–6%** (management noted this could trend toward the low end if PEO conversions stay strong)
- Adjusted operating margin: **~44%**
- Effective tax rate: **~24%**
- Adjusted diluted EPS growth: **7%–9%**

Management added color that if Q1's PEO upsell and HCM referral momentum continues, PEO and Insurance Solutions could trend toward the high end of the updated range.

Sources:
- https://marketchameleon.com/articles/b/2026/9/23/payx-fq1-2027-results-42-percent-adjusted-operating-margin-peo-insurance-growth
- https://www.stocktitan.net/news/PAYX/paychex-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-2027-io8royzod0jl.html
- https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262183489-tradingkey
- https://seekingalpha.com/news/4646250-paychex-reaffirms-fy2027-guidance-updates-peo-and-insurance-growth-to-7-percentminus-8

Note: This reflects guidance from the most recent earnings release available in my search. Since my knowledge of the current date may lag, I'd recommend confirming against Paychex's latest investor materials (paychex.com/investor-relations) in case a newer quarter has since been reported.
